assets.name: fish

Authentic low-resolution 16-bit pixel art, bold dark pixel outline, restrained 12-color palette, deliberately chunky square pixels, crisp stepped edges, no antialiasing or gradients. Single item centered, entire object visible, wide transparent padding. Square image. No numbers, words, labels, UI, scenery, spaceship, energy crystals, watermark or ground shadow. Broad clean central shape readable at 50 pixels.
